what: A 20px accent dot follows the mouse one step on the event, then .4 of the remaining distance each frame. Over links · buttons it grows to 50px over .2s back.inOut(2.594 — Webflow inOutBack, 10% overshoot), and over cards with data-cursor it becomes a 100px circle over .5s back.out, with its text (”View work”) turning on .5s after a .2s delay. On leaving, it returns to 20px over .5s. Not attached on touch devices

options.grow: Diameter over links and buttons (px), default 50
options.big: Diameter (px) of the ball on data-cursor, default 100
options.lerp: Follow ratio per frame, default .4 — at 1 it snaps right on
options.links: Selector for what grows, default a, button, [data-fx-part=grow] — in the original only buttons, tabs and journal cards grow, so narrow it down like [data-cursor-grow]
options.hide: If 1, hides the system cursor inside the attached panel (as in the original)
options.--fx-dot · --fx-label-ink: Dot color and text color (via style), default --kf-accent · --kf-on-accent
options.[data-cursor]: Text to float inside the element that becomes the large circle
options.blend: Dot blending (mix-blend-mode), none by default — the original uses exclusion (orange dots look blue over bright bands)
options.hideout: 1 turns the dots off when leaving the window — by default they stay, as in the original
options.growdur: Duration of the grow-on-hover over links and buttons (seconds), default .2
options.[data-cursor-stick]: Attached to a data-cursor element, the big circle·text stays even after leaving (until moving onto another spot) — Brand hero strip
options.ease: Curve for growing and shrinking, default back.inOut(2.594) — the site builder’s inOutBack is a Bezier approximation, so brand uses 0.68,-0.55,0.265,1.55 (CustomEase needed)
options.lag: Seconds to delay the start of growing, default 0 — a typical interaction tool starts one frame (.017) late

from.where: shared.js (.cursor — site builder Mouse Expand In/Out · Mouse Expand Project Hover)
